# Q3 Sales Report

## Executive Summary

This report summarizes the sales performance for Q3 2024.
Revenue increased by 15% compared to the same period last year.

## Key Metrics

- Total Revenue: $4.2M
- New Customers: 312
- Retention Rate: 87%
- Net Promoter Score: 42

## Regional Performance

### North America
Revenue grew 18% driven by enterprise deals.
The team closed 5 deals over $100K.

### Europe
Steady growth of 12% with strong performance in the UK and Germany.

### Asia Pacific
Emerging market with 25% growth, primarily in Japan and Australia.

## Outlook

Q4 pipeline looks strong with $2.1M in qualified opportunities.
We expect continued momentum through the holiday season.
